headlines.title: China’s factory-gate price growth picks up in August as Iran war fuels energy volatility
headlines.summary:

headlines.title: 研究报告预计：中国入境游未来10年或迎3万亿元市场增量
headlines.summary: 9月10日，中国商务部研究院国际服务贸易研究所在服贸会上发布《入境游促进消费的内在机理及增长潜力研究》，该报告在携程集团支持下完成，报告尤其关注中国入境游发展现状与特点。报告称，中国入境游已形成较好基础，有望迈入高质量发展新阶段，预计未来10年中国入境旅游收入占GDP比重有望提升至国际平均水平，这意味着约1万亿至3万亿元人民币的潜在市场增量。（环球时报）

headlines.title_en: Research report forecasts: China's inbound tourism may see a 3 trillion yuan market increment over the next 10 years
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, the International Trade in Services Research Institute of the Chinese Academy of International Trade and Economic Cooperation under the Ministry of Commerce released a study on the internal mechanisms and growth potential of inbound tourism in promoting consumption at the China International Fair for Trade in Services. The report, completed with the support of Trip.com Group, focused in particular on the current development status and characteristics of China's inbound tourism. The report said China's inbound tourism has already formed a solid foundation and is expected to enter a new stage of high-quality development. It is expected that in the next 10 years, the share of China's inbound tourism revenue in GDP will rise to the international average, implying potential market growth of about 1 trillion to 3 trillion yuan. (Global Times)

headlines.title_en: The two-year US Treasury real yield rose about 12.5 basis points on the day of the US CPI inflation release; the two-year US Treasury yield rose over 25.9 basis points for the week
headlines.summary_en: Friday (September 11) New York late trading: the US 10-year benchmark Treasury yield rose 0.43 basis point to 4.9669%. At 20:30 Beijing time, when US CPI inflation data was released, it was pushed up to 4.9792%, continuing to approach the October 23, 2023 peak of 5.0187%, then fell rapidly and at 21:03 dropped to 4.9016%, refreshing a daily low. It showed a W-shaped trend throughout the day and rose 18.48 basis points for the week. The two-year US Treasury yield rose 3.98 basis points to 4.6254%, reaching 4.6551% when the CPI inflation report was released, and rose 25.93 basis points for the week, with gains accelerating on September 10.

headlines.title_en: The US dollar index surged then retreated after the US CPI inflation data release
headlines.summary_en: Friday (September 11) New York late trading: the ICE US Dollar Index rose 0.07% to 99.118 points. The release of US CPI inflation data at 20:30 Beijing time brought a sharp short-term spike and pullback. It was roughly flat for the week, with a trading range of 1,184.82-1,192.98 points, showing an overall V-shaped trend and refreshing the period high when the CPI data was released. The Bloomberg Dollar Index fell 0.02% to 1,190.45 points, down 0.02% for the week, with a trading range of 1,184.82-1,192.98 points.

headlines.title_en: China warns against arbitrarily expanding the scope of Sudan sanctions
headlines.summary_en: Sun Lei, Chargé d'Affaires ad interim of China's Permanent Mission to the United Nations, made an explanatory statement on September 11 after the Security Council voted on a draft resolution concerning Sudan sanctions, warning against arbitrarily expanding the scope of sanctions. Sun Lei said that given obvious differences among Security Council members, the penholder the United States proposed a one-month technical extension of the authorization for sanctions measures on Sudan's Darfur region, allowing more time for discussion, and China did not object and voted in favor. China has consistently advocated ensuring the objectivity, fairness and inclusiveness of draft resolutions and avoiding forcing through texts with obvious controversies. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 对冲基金在贝森特自称庄家前已经大幅削减日元空头仓位
headlines.summary: 在美国财政部长贝森特公开挑战交易员、要求他们检验自己推动日元走强的决心之前，对冲基金已经大幅削减日元空头仓位。 美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）公布的数据显示，截至9月8日当周，杠杆交易员对日元的看空押注减少了一半。 这一变化发生在贝森特发表相关言论之前不久。当时贝森特在一场活动上向交易员放话，欢迎他们押注与自己相反的方向，他说自己掌握了日本央行和日元政策一些信息，是“庄家”。 与此同时，数据显示，包括资产管理公司和非商业交易者在内的投机性外汇交易员，截至9月8日当周连续第六周削减看涨美元的押注，规模降至194亿美元。

headlines.title_en: Hedge funds had already significantly cut yen short positions before Bessent called himself the bookmaker
headlines.summary_en: Before US Treasury Secretary Bessent publicly challenged traders to test his determination to push the yen stronger, hedge funds had already sharply cut bearish yen positions. Data released by the US Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) showed that in the week ended September 8, leveraged traders halved their bearish bets on the yen. This change occurred shortly before Bessent made related remarks. At an event at the time, Bessent told traders he welcomed them to bet against him, saying he had some information about the Bank of Japan and yen policy and was "the house." Meanwhile, the data showed that speculative FX traders, including asset managers and non-commercial traders, cut bullish dollar bets for a sixth consecutive week in the week ended September 8, reducing the scale to $19.4 billion.
